corroboration.rationale: Single permitted approved directory source (Mad Barn). Second source (professionalfarriers.com) is conditional/blocked and cannot be used. No independent corroboration.

freshness.rationale: Mad Barn directory retrieved 2026-08-23 with current active listing. Within the 365-day freshness window.

completeness.rationale: Confidence-stage minimum data met: identity resolved sufficiently, segment confirmed as needs_review, at least one permitted evidence record, qualification criteria present. Gaps: no standalone website, no current activity evidence, location discrepancy noted.

mandatory_claim_inference_only.rationale: Mandatory criterion farrier.professional_activity is directly confirmed by directory listing with professional certification titles and business name.

unresolved_identity_conflict.rationale: Identity is sufficiently resolved. Minor location discrepancy (Lexington vs Georgetown) flagged in conflicts but does not prevent identity resolution.
